# Electron Stagewright

> MCP server for driving, inspecting, and asserting on real Electron apps. Agent-native by
> design: numbered snapshot refs instead of CSS guessing, a family of single-call expect
> assertions, structured error envelopes with stable codes and recovery hints.

## Install (Claude Code)

Requires Node.js 24 or newer. Run these from a terminal before the MCP host starts the server; keep
the `--package` list identical in all three commands. `install-electron` downloads Electron's
binary up front, because its first-use download prints to stdout and would corrupt the MCP stdio
stream. `doctor --json` must report `"ok": true`. Keep `--prefix ~/`: without it, `npx` skips any
listed package the current project already has, and the server cannot load it.

```bash
npx -y --prefix ~/ --package @electron-stagewright/core@0.6.3 \
  --package playwright@1.63.0 --package electron@42.11.10 install-electron
npx -y --prefix ~/ --package @electron-stagewright/core@0.6.3 \
  --package playwright@1.63.0 --package electron@42.11.10 electron-stagewright doctor --json
claude mcp add electron-stagewright -- \
  npx -y --prefix ~/ --package @electron-stagewright/core@0.6.3 \
  --package playwright@1.63.0 --package electron@42.11.10 \
  electron-stagewright --tool-profile essential
```

Then `claude mcp list` should show the server as connected. First call: `electron_launch` with the
absolute path to the app's built main entry, then `electron_snapshot`, and end with `electron_stop`.
Other hosts use the same command and arguments in their own config shape; see Connect your MCP client
below. Codex: `codex mcp add electron-stagewright -- <the npx command above>`, then set
`startup_timeout_sec = 30` and, on Linux, `env_vars = ["DISPLAY", "WAYLAND_DISPLAY", "XAUTHORITY"]`
on that server in `~/.codex/config.toml`. VS Code: `.vscode/mcp.json` uses a top-level `servers`
key with `"type": "stdio"`. Desktop hosts opened from the Dock may need the absolute `npx` path and
an `env.PATH` that contains Node.js. To update later, run `install-electron` and `doctor` with the new
package list first, then change every pinned version in the host config together (plugins need the
matching core) while keeping the existing flags (in Claude Code, read them with
`claude mcp get electron-stagewright`, then remove and add the entry in the same scope), restart the
host, and check `runtime.server.core` in the `doctor --json` report; see "Update to a new release"
in Connect your MCP client.

## Docs

- [Tool reference](https://github.com/electron-stagewright/electron-stagewright/blob/main/TOOL-REFERENCE.md): every tool with parameters, return shapes, and error codes — generated from the live manifest
- [Getting started](https://github.com/electron-stagewright/electron-stagewright/blob/main/docs/guides/getting-started.md): contributor tutorial that clones and builds the repository to drive the bundled example (to install the published package, use Connect your MCP client)
- [Try the packaged demo](https://github.com/electron-stagewright/electron-stagewright/blob/main/docs/guides/demo.md): pinned npx bootstrap and host entries for a local-only modal/list/multi-window Electron app that proves a host can drive Electron
- [Connect your MCP client](https://github.com/electron-stagewright/electron-stagewright/blob/main/docs/guides/connect-your-mcp-client.md): wire the published package into Claude Code, Codex, Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, opencode, or any MCP host (npx/global/local command forms), verify it connected, update or remove it, troubleshoot stdio/config failures
- [Launch, attach, or inject](https://github.com/electron-stagewright/electron-stagewright/blob/main/docs/guides/launch-or-attach.md): the three ways to get a session against an app
- [Assert UI state](https://github.com/electron-stagewright/electron-stagewright/blob/main/docs/guides/assert-ui-state.md): refs, the expect family, waits, snapshot diffs
- [Type into code editors](https://github.com/electron-stagewright/electron-stagewright/blob/main/docs/guides/type-into-code-editors.md): the reliable Monaco/EditContext/CodeMirror typing path (electron_type_into_editor), replace and clear, the auto-pairing caveat, attached-not-visible waits, and verifying the text landed
- [Capture diagnostics](https://github.com/electron-stagewright/electron-stagewright/blob/main/docs/guides/capture-diagnostics.md): screenshots, console logs, dialogs, session traces
- [Load, configure, and diagnose plugins](https://github.com/electron-stagewright/electron-stagewright/blob/main/docs/guides/plugins.md): explicit plugin loading, narrow gates, and effective configuration
- [Migrate from electron-driver](https://github.com/electron-stagewright/electron-stagewright/blob/main/docs/guides/migrate-from-electron-driver.md): tool-by-tool mapping
- [Choose an Electron MCP server](https://github.com/electron-stagewright/electron-stagewright/blob/main/docs/guides/choosing-an-electron-mcp-server.md): capability-first workflow comparison and a reproducible evaluation checklist
- [Compatibility](https://github.com/electron-stagewright/electron-stagewright/blob/main/docs/guides/compatibility.md): verified runtime, platform, and transport combinations plus explicit limits
- [Concepts](https://github.com/electron-stagewright/electron-stagewright/blob/main/docs/guides/concepts.md): the agent-native model and why -- envelope, refs, snapshots, retrying assertions, sessions/transports, eval and plugins -- each linked to its ADR
- [Security model](https://github.com/electron-stagewright/electron-stagewright/blob/main/docs/guides/security-model.md): trust boundaries, the controls behind --allow-eval, residual risks, and a deployment checklist
- [Architecture decisions](https://github.com/electron-stagewright/electron-stagewright/blob/main/docs/adr/README.md): the numbered design record

## Optional

- [Example app and scripted session](https://github.com/electron-stagewright/electron-stagewright/blob/main/examples/minimal-app/README.md): the runnable hello world
- [Contributing](https://github.com/electron-stagewright/electron-stagewright/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md): conventions and the public-repo content policy
- [Governance](https://github.com/electron-stagewright/electron-stagewright/blob/main/.github/GOVERNANCE.md): roles, decision-making, and the co-maintainer path
